tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search the brands listed on Koddeo (banks, crypto, delivery, VPN, e-commerce...) that have community referral codes. Returns each brand's slug, to use with get_company_codes or publish_code.

tools.name: get_company_codes
tools.description: List the active community referral codes for one brand, in the same order as on its Koddeo page (boosted and Premium codes first).

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: The connected user's plan, daily refresh quota and number of published codes.

tools.name: list_my_codes
tools.description: The connected user's referral codes with views, clicks and Boost status.

tools.name: publish_code
tools.description: Publish one of the user's referral codes on a brand page. One code per brand per user. Provide a code, a referral link, or both.

tools.name: refresh_code
tools.description: Bump one of the user's codes back up its brand page ranking.

tools.name: refresh_all_codes
tools.description: Bump every active code of the user at once. Free accounts get 1 per day (Paris time); Premium is unlimited.

tools.name: boost_code
tools.description: Create a Stripe checkout to pin one of the user's codes to the top of its brand page. Prices: 48h €0.79, 1 week €1.49, 3 weeks €2.99. Returns a payment link the user must open to pay; the Boost starts as soon as payment succeeds.

tools.name: subscribe_premium
tools.description: Create a Stripe checkout for Koddeo Premium (automatic refresh, Premium badge, priority ranking): €5.99/month or €47.88/year. Returns a link the user must open to pay. If already subscribed, returns the billing portal.
